business_problem: A series of mergers and acquisitions left Visual Comfort & Co. with fragmented product and customer data. A complex supply chain featuring overseas manufacturing and shipping made it hard for sales staff to know when products would be available.
solution_summary: A series of mergers and acquisitions left Visual Comfort & Co. with fragmented product and customer data. A complex supply chain featuring overseas manufacturing and shipping made it hard for sales staff to know when products would be available. So Visual Comfort & Co. consolidated data with Microsoft Fabric and connected Dynamics 365 to its wholesale enterprise resource planning software to deliver real-time inventory visibility in the showroom and online. One of the key benefits of Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for Visual Comfort & Co. is real-time inventory management. All the company’s lighting fixtures are manufactured overseas and shipped to the United States for customization before final delivery to the customer. Overseas shipping often includes unexpected delays, such as weather events. In addition, during peak times or promotional events, sales staff had no visibility into product availability or projected delivery times.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Consolidates product and customer data into a shared analytics foundation for inventory and order visibility.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates inventory, order, warehouse, and planning workflows with real-time supply-chain visibility.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Acts as the core cloud business application platform that unifies operational workflows and shared data.

business_outcome: Since implementing Dynamics 365, Visual Comfort & Co. has seen improvements in order accuracy and the ability to forecast product deliveries. The enhanced visibility into the supply chain has also optimized inventory management, reducing excess stock and improving warehouse efficiency.
architecture_clues: Product and customer data is consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, then Dynamics 365 exchanges inventory and order context with SAP and Oracle's JD Edwards so showrooms and online channels can see current product availability.
